results.text: High standards of corporate governance and compliance with the principles and rules governing its business operations are a core concern of the Elis Group and its Supervisory Board. Since being changed into a joint-stock corporation in 2014, the Group has adopted a dual-board system of governance comprising a management board and a supervisory board, believing that this provides a better balance of power and benefits all stakeholders. The quality of the Board's work is assured by the active involvement of its members and facilitated by the role of the three committees described in this chapter. General management of the Group The Management Board and Executive Committee, both of which are chaired by the Chairman of the Management Board, Xavier Martir, oversee the general management of the Group. (b) Number of shares as at December 31, 2025 (see chapter 6, section 6.2.3 of this Universal Registration Document, which describes transactions in the Company's shares carried out by its executives in 2025). This number includes share-based consideration consisting of units of the "Elis Shareholding" investment fund (FCPE) as well as the vested performance shares held by each member of the Management Board as at December 31, 2025. Status of the terms of office of the members of the Management Board There were no changes in the composition of the Management Board in 2025. The members of the Management Board were reappointed in 2022 for four-year terms and will be submitted for reappointment before September 5, 2026.
